CaseIdentity.description:
The case's reference number, its owner and the owner's deputy; only the fields sent are changed, an empty one is
taken away (the owner then is again who created the case).
CaseIdentity.title: CaseIdentity

EntryForm.description:
The handler's own entry of the running account («Notiz hinzufügen»): what kind, with whom, when, what was said, and
at most one row each of what was agreed, asked and the next step.
EntryForm.title: EntryForm

Feedback.description: A case worker's verdict on one result item; target names the item, never its content.
Feedback.title: Feedback

ReviewMark.description: A jurist's mark on one element of the legal content; «Änderung nötig» and «Frage» say why in a comment.
ReviewMark.title: ReviewMark

get.description: Content-free and pseudonymous: counts, ratios and durations from the event log, tied to the manifest.

post.description:
A new case from its files in one gesture: named from the first e-mail's subject or the first file's name,
and its preparation started at once; a file given twice is kept once («skipped»).

delete.description:
Delete a case with everything derived from it: its owner, the deputy or a reviewer; a content-free record
stays (who, when, how much).

post.description: 'Andere Handlung': the handler picks another action kind with a one-tap reason; the draft and the date follow.

«Freigeben»: approve the prepared letter's current version and store its Versandpaket (the exact text, the
enclosures, the file note and the follow-up, one folder per recipient) in the same request. Refused while the
version changed, new files are unread, a gap or a required part is open, a decision is open, or a part the handler
edited changed meanwhile. The same request again, or the same version while its approval still holds, returns
that record; a version whose approval no longer holds (a file came, a jurist marked what it rests on) is approved
anew, with its own package («Erneut freigeben»).

«Versandt am»: the handler confirms that an approved version went out, on a day and by a channel, per recipient
(all of the version's by default). Each recipient is written once into the account (an entry of the form's record
kind and code, with what it asked and the questions it answered); a version that no longer holds is accepted and
flagged. The day is not after today and not before the approval (or a copy of the same text).

«Abgleich erledigt»: a letter that went out rests on a fact that changed since, or on legal content a jurist
marked since; the handler checked it against the case as it stands and it stays as sent (a correction would be its
own letter). Records the premise and the marks it was checked against; a later change flags it again. The letter
that went out keeps its version: nothing is unsent.

get.description: The Versandpaket stored when the version was approved: «Versandpaket_<Referenz oder Fall>_<TT.MM.JJJJ>.zip».
One document of a stored Versandpaket (the letter's form or an enclosure's kind), as .docx.

post.description:
«übernehmen»: the handler takes the drafted answer to a customer's question (its point, and the intent it
answers); the question is then «beantwortet (Fallbearbeitung)» while the point applies. 422 when the point does
not apply on the case's facts or the intent is not one of its answers.
'Stand am': a new case holding only the chosen pages of the case's PDF, read text carried over, nothing read again.

put.description:
The handler's text of the prepared letter or one of its enclosures (``form``), saved per part while typing. It
survives a reload, a handoff and a restart; a part re-rendered later keeps the handler's text where its base did
not change. 409 «Inzwischen von … geändert: neu laden» when ``parent_id`` is not the latest save of the form; an
``op_id`` already stored returns its first result.

post.description:
A part the handler had edited and the case changed meanwhile: «meine Fassung behalten» (``mine``) or «neue
Fassung übernehmen» (``new``); saved like the handler's text.

«Notiz hinzufügen»: the handler's own entry of the running account (a call, a conversation, a note, an e-mail
outside the file). It counts at once, without a model: the account, «Stand», the dates and the next action are
recomputed from it. Kept as an edit of the case and logged like every handler gesture.

delete.description: A handler's entry removed: it no longer counts; the edit stays in the store and the removal is logged.

put.description: A handler's entry changed: the one in force is replaced by a new edit with the same number; logged.

post.description: A gesture the browser saw (exposure, a source opened, a note, the letter copied, the case closed).

Files into a case as one deliberate import (``files``; ``file`` from older clients): each is stored, an e-mail's
attachments as files of their own. A file the case already holds is refused before it is read and named in
«skipped» (409 when every file is one), an attachment the case holds is skipped and remembered on its e-mail. Where
the deployment starts updates by itself (CASEPATH_AUTO_UPDATE), a prepared case then gets one bounded update of
what came in; «auto» says so («gestartet») or why not («aus», «zu_gross», «lauf_aktiv», or why «Aktualisieren» is
blocked). A file into a closed case reopens it. An older client's one ``file`` gets its row, these keys added.
Fix the case's latest completed run for a study: every expert's copy will show exactly this run.

The mail address a letter of this case goes to, for one recipient, as the handler sets it: it replaces the one
found in the file (or none) from now on, attributed. Empty takes the address away. Nothing is sent.

put.description: «Mehr»: move a case into the historic files or out of them; logged, the latest word governs.

The case's reference number, its owner and deputy, as a person sets them (each change attributed in the case's
log). A reference number another case carries is refused: one number is one case.

post.description: A casepath.labels/1 file for this case, checked against its process and kept in the case store (replaced whole).

get.description: The file's documents in time order from the stored run, the insurer's own marked, and labels to complete. Inside only.

Review in the letter: the letter prepared in this case and every reviewed element it rests on, in the shape of a
review row (one group per kind of element), so a jurist marks them beside the real letter and a handler sees what
is checked. Marks are set by the same route as everywhere (POST /api/review/{file}/{element}).

post.description:
The handler's answer to the open offer of the other side (annehmen, ablehnen, Gegenangebot), attributed and per
offer: the letter to the other side is prepared from it (process/live.py). 409 where no offer waits for one.
The own answer before CasePath's result: stored, hashed and frozen with the reveal, once per person and case.

«Empfehlung»: the handler adopts the proposed ways («übernehmen») or picks among the ways that hold, one per
wish («ändern»). The adoption names the proposal it was made on; it lapses when a chosen way no longer holds or the
proposal changes. The prospects of success are judged on their own (set_fact aussichten, Art. 169 AVO): adopting a
way judges nothing about them.

get.description:
The case report for the case file: what the last prepared run found, each finding with its source. After an
update the result checker's fields stand under the full preparation's date; the letter is the one the case shows.
A session starts only if this is still true; the screen refuses to start otherwise.

post.description: One expert's own copy of a frozen case: the same files, the frozen run, no run of its own.

«Vertretung übernehmen»: a colleague opens a case that is not theirs by becoming its deputy, attributed in the
case's log where its owner sees it. The owner stays the owner.
«Aktualisieren»: a run that reads only the files the latest completed run did not read, and builds on it.

Undo a correction: everything that follows from the case's state follows back (the package's before and after);
what already left CasePath cannot be undone and is named (``limits``).

get.description: Case files placed in the volume's incoming folder (and one level of subfolders), and which are imported.

post.description: One case per file: a dossier placed in the volume becomes a case without passing through the browser.

«Freigeben»: only an item whose replay is of its current version and, for a refinement, of the version of the
item it refines as it is now; it then applies exactly the transformation the replay applied (activation).

«Nachspielen»: the item's current version applied to every prepared case without a model; what it would change
is kept on the item, and only then can it be activated («Freigeben»).

get.description: What this running app is: code tree, workflows and Knowledge, each hashed by content.

Whether runs the reader's browser is waiting for are done: {runs: {id: status}}, nothing of their cases. The
screen asks while a run it started is at work and the reader is elsewhere, and then says «fertig».

«Welche Briefe beruhen darauf?»: the letters approved on a rule (a Knowledge item and, if given, its version; a
reviewed element; a version of the process), across the cases. A reviewer's question; no letter text.
Every labelled point replayed from its case's stored run: one row per point and the summary table.
The rows of «Rechtsgebiete», each with its state and counts, and whether the signed-in person may mark.

The reviewed elements ordered by use: how many approved letters rest on each (the approvals' own ``relies``,
across the cases), those not yet «geprüft» first, so a jurist releases first what letters actually carry. Each
with the case of the latest such letter, to review it there. No case content.
The requested changes and questions for the developers: element id, mark, comment, suggested wording. No case content.

post.description: «geprüft», «Änderung nötig» or «Frage» on one element, for the content as it is now; stored and logged.

get.description: One area (or the cover check, the letters): every element with its content, passages, source and open question.
The same content as one plain page, to print.

post.description: 'Weiter': continue a paused run from what it established; finished steps are not done again.

'Verwerfen': a paused run is set aside (kept in the store and the log, never deleted); the case shows its last
completed result again, or is not yet prepared.

get.description:
The result checker's reply draft of a full preparation; an update inherited it (409). Once the letter the case
shows is approved, that approved letter itself (the Versandpaket's own Brief.docx).

post.description: 'Anhalten': the run ends before its next model turn and keeps what is established (status "paused").

get.description:
One expert's session: the practice case, then the frozen study cases in an order rotated by the expert's position,
the own answer first on the first of them (FEEDBACK_DESIGN, review point 5). Built, not used until the study opens.

post.description: The daily pass, now (a reviewer's gesture; it otherwise runs by itself every CASEPATH_TICK_MINUTES).

get.description:
What happened on the reader's cases since they last looked (``since``, kept by the reader's own browser), newest
first: what CasePath noticed by itself (the daily pass), a preparation or an update that finished, and what a
colleague did. {since, events [{case, reference, title, what, by, at}], tick}. Only cases the reader may open; the
reader's own (owner or deputy) where any case is theirs.
